customModesDesc: Create and manage custom agent modes with specific tools, prompts, and behaviors.
description: Configure defaults, your API key, prompt presets, MCP servers and more.
desktopOnlySectionBody: This section administers the desktop app on the machine it runs on: its window chrome, that device's own pairing, or work that has not moved off the local shell yet. Pairing a host does not open it; open Cognia on the machine you want to configure.
hostUnavailableSectionBody: This section administers a capability the host you are connected to doesn't provide — it needs the desktop app, or a paired host that runs it. Open Cognia there to use it.
title: Settings
